info.title: WP Career Board REST API
info.description:
REST API for WP Career Board (Free). Namespaced under `wcb/v1`. WP Career Board Pro adds its own routes to the same namespace; those are catalogued in the Pro plugin's own spec.

This document is generated from the live route registrations and scoped to the routes this plugin registers, so it never includes routes from Pro or any other plugin on the same install.

servers.description: Your WordPress site (replace with your domain)

appPassword.description: A WordPress Application Password (issue one with POST /wcb/v1/auth/app-password, or Users -> Profile -> Application Passwords). Send it as HTTP Basic auth.

cookieNonce.name: X-WP-Nonce
cookieNonce.description: For same-origin browser requests using the logged-in WordPress cookie: send the wp_rest nonce in the X-WP-Nonce header.

industries.description: Ordered slug/label pairs to persist as the registry.

removals.description: What to do with companies still storing a removed slug.

app_name.description: Name shown beside this credential in your profile.

app_id.description: Stable per-install id, so a repeat sign-in replaces the row instead of adding another.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (keyword searches), newest (featured first), oldest, salary, closing. Default: relevance with a keyword, else the Settings default.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of the search origin point.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude of the search origin point.

reason.description: Rejection reason sent to the employer.
Why the visitor is reporting this job.

action.description: How to resolve the flag: dismiss the reports or unpublish the job.
